name: Greater Chicagoland
author: NerdieSanders
description:
**Greater Chicagoland** spans Cook, DuPage, Will, Lake County (IL), and Lake County (IN) — from the Wisconsin state line south through Will County, west to the Fox River Valley, and east across the Indiana line into the Calumet region.

High-quality demand from U.S. Census **LODES** data, with special demand for **O'Hare & Midway airports**, **10 universities**, **39 entertainment & attraction venues** (Soldier Field, Wrigley Field, Navy Pier, Museum Campus, Six Flags Great America, casinos, malls, and more), and **Naval Station Great Lakes**.
